answer: Each agent bonds stake to a Semaphore identity commitment and evaluates an epoch polynomial at a nullifier-derived point; proofs bind the evaluation while hiding the secret. Reusing a nullifier in duplicate messages produces distinct Shamir shares; interpolation reveals the private key, enabling verifiers to slash the bond immediately. Domain labels such as grove, tundra, and timber separate contexts, while the per-identity rate limit makes creating extra pseudonyms costly rather than free.
